Members reached general agreement on a phased plan: roof work and transition space at TCP first, then Ritter and a new town hall.
Phase three, tied to either TCP or Turkey Hill, was left unresolved; the committee agreed to seek a joint meeting with the school committee.

what_happened.line: The committee took no vote beyond adjournment, but leaned toward Ritter as the first phase, paired with a roof repair at TC Passios; no formal decision was recorded.
A placeholder request for ARPA funds for professional design help is before the select board; members appeared to agree it should target renderings and more detailed early-phase costs.
The chair will work with Heather to adapt the prior RFP scope, with alternates for services the committee might supply itself, and bring it to the next meeting.
Members said the TC Passios roof work is expensive and the select board wants it folded into a bigger plan; one member said serious funding will likely need an override vote.
The next meeting was set for September 18.

why_it_matters: The committee is working out how to stage the replacement or repair of four town buildings, and any large share of the cost would probably come to voters as an override or town meeting question.
ARPA money is described as coming from outside the local tax base, but it has deadlines for commitment and spending, which sets the pace for how soon design work can start.

meetings.headline: Committee settled on a phased hybrid plan (Ritter, Town Hall, then TC Passios) and will meet the select board on the 16th.
meetings.summary: The Municipal Building Design Committee used the hybrid concept to plug in rough square footage and a per-square-foot cost to get a ceiling estimate. Members debated Town Hall's ADA access and lot-line encroachment, whether to show numbers to the public at all, and how to phase the work. They agreed to return to the select board for guidance. The only formal vote was adjournment.

what_happened.line: The committee reached informal consensus on phasing: Ritter building first, Town Hall second, TC Passios third.
No formal vote was taken except adjournment; the committee agreed to return to the select board to finalize the hybrid concept and seek guidance.
A rough square-footage and per-foot cost method produced a ceiling estimate for three buildings, and members debated whether to show numbers to the public at all.
Members agreed any cost figures shown will be heavily qualified as notional and for comparison only.
A joint meeting with the select board is planned for Tuesday the 16th, with the chair to confirm the time.

why_it_matters: The phase order and the rough cost ceiling shape which town buildings are proposed first, and any resulting project would eventually come to residents as a funding vote at town meeting.
The estimates are notional, built from an earlier renovation's per-foot cost, so residents should treat them as a comparison tool rather than a price.

A possible town meeting warrant article for a community kitchen, floated at the end of the meeting.
